endpoint: prepared shared input to completed classification top1/top5 after required owned outputs and TRT synchronization
input_policy: Use the exact historical prepared UINT8 tensor for timing. Separate canaries use its deterministic complement and32 predefined varied requests. Native canary explicitly adds per-submit input filling, so it cannot validate arbitrary-input support of the historical fixed-input wrapper.

factors.F1: original product parallelism versus globally one outstanding task released after classification completion
factors.F2: complete Generic versus Native backend and handoff chain bundle, including SDK wrappers, layout, conversion and copies. Not an isolated copy factor.
factors.N_single: sameNative workers with inflight1 and whole-task semaphore1

drift_rules.before: Require registered physical identity, exclusive product lock, no competing work, exact artifacts/sources, fixed CPU/GPU frequencies/power mode/affinity, CPU thermal40..65C with <=2C change over2s, no active throttle alert.
drift_rules.thermal_scope: Prespecified comparability band, not a hardware safety threshold. End temperatures descriptive. Warmup30s fully drains before measurement.
drift_rules.after: Require unchanged pins/profile/clocks/power/affinity, no active throttle alerts or competing work, every accepted task completed. No selection of middle or faster windows.
drift_rules.failed: Retain every attempt. Stop on failure. Repeat only after documented corrected technical cause. Changed code/profile/artifacts requires separate series. No selective cell extension.
drift_rules.incomplete_blocks: Exclude incomplete blocks from paired estimates, report their full attempts and reasons. Never count frames as process replications.

primary_analysis.unit: independent worker process, paired within full randomized block
primary_analysis.rate: all completed accepted tasks divided by full measurement makespan including queue fill and drain; not60second core rate
primary_analysis.cut_ratio: b123/b052 for RegNet, b095/b002 for ResNet, pervariant and sameblock
primary_analysis.summary: geometric mean ratio, sample SD of logratios and two-sided Student-t95percent interval across blocks
primary_analysis.mechanism_scope: Report continuous intervention effects and observed stage capacities/waits. Whole-chain contrast cannot identify an individual copy/conversion cause. Current-code intervention does not automatically reconstruct historical causes.
primary_analysis.replication: Apply Native product versus Native globally-single intervention to ResNet without tuning. If primary scheduling mechanism unsupported, label second diagnosis, not confirmatory mechanism replication.

extension_rule: After exactly5 complete primary blocks, extend exactlyonce by5fullblocks if t95percent interval of G_product or N_product logcutratio or interaction contains0. No further extension. Maximum100 scheduled confirmatory processes in this protocol, under task160cap.
reuse_original_cells: G_product and N_product retain actual product initialization/stagefunctions/copies/endpoint andparallelism. They count as originalrunner comparisons within matrix, not additionalreplicates. Adapter duration/warmup/report deviations disclosed.

pilot_prerequisites.note: All pilot stages use the same unchanged adapter/controller as confirmation; rates are excluded from confirmatory estimates.
